name: get_spec
description: 按 id 读取规范文档的完整内容。spec id 是 agent/prompts/main/spec/ 下的相对路径（不含 .md 扩展名，如 "coding/typescript"、"safety"）。先使用 list_spec 发现可用的 spec id。返回规范的 Markdown 正文（去除 front-matter）。
description_en: Read the full content of a spec document by id. A spec id is the relative path (without .md extension) under agent/prompts/main/spec/, e.g. "coding/typescript", "safety". Use list_spec first to discover available spec ids. Returns the spec's Markdown body (front-matter stripped).

spec.description: 要读取的 spec id（相对路径不含 .md，如 "coding/typescript"）
spec.description_en: The spec id to read (relative path without .md, e.g. "coding/typescript")
